runs.formHint: One run is created per month, covering the employees under an active contract in it.
runs.confirmHint: A payroll run is created for this month with the employees on active contracts in it.
runs.emptyHint: Create the month's run to compute the employees' pay and approve it.

actions.approveHint: After approval the inputs and amounts are locked and cannot be changed.
actions.cancelHint: The run is deleted with all its payslips and inputs. You can create it again later.
actions.postHint: The payroll entry is created in accounting and the run can no longer be changed. Review the proposed entry above.
actions.paymentHint: The net pay is recorded as paid from the chosen journal on the given date.
actions.eosProvisionTitle: Post the end-of-service provision for this month?
actions.eosProvisionHint: The provision entry is created in accounting for this run's month and cannot be posted twice for the same month.

warnings.title: Warnings to review
warnings.compensation_missing: {name}: no compensation recorded, so they are left out of the computation.
warnings.contract_missing: {name}: has compensation but no running contract this month, so they are left out of the computation. Check the contract start date.
warnings.missing_iban: {name}: no IBAN recorded, and every positive net needs one. Complete the IBAN in the compensation before approving.
warnings.missing_iban_snapshot: {name}: the payment data snapshot taken when this run was approved is incomplete, so the transfer file cannot be created. Changing the IBAN in the compensation now will not change this run. Contact the payroll administrator or support for a documented correction.
warnings.unmapped_department: {name}: their department has no cost center, so the cost goes to the default cost center or none.

register.title: Payroll register
register.hint: The month's inputs and every employee's figures. Inputs can be edited before approval.
register.emptyDraftHint: Compute the payroll to see each employee's payslip.

mine.emptyHint: Your payslip appears here once the company approves the month's run.

compensation.bankKept: The bank on record is kept as it is.
compensation.nationalityHint: Read from the employee record; set it in the employee edit page.

compensation.amountInvalid: Enter an amount of zero or more.

compensation.relationshipWarningTitle: Check the regulatory effect of this classification
compensation.relationshipWarningBody: The calculation still applies GOSI, wage protection (WPS) and the end-of-service award as for an employee. Saudi labor law looks at the actual relationship, not the contract's name, so confirm the classification with your advisor. This is a warning only; it does not block the run or the payment.
